reviewer: Codex visual inspection; advisor round 1 corrections
findings: Inspected all four regenerated Blender previews: full object is framed with the original steel, graphite and blue-green palette.
Two deck-flush independent treads at each terminal lead into gradually opening/closing risers; the former 20cm entry jump is removed.
Reverse three-quarter and side views show a continuous metal skirt beneath the glass channel without the former repeated exposed tread sides and gaps.
Handrails and glass follow the flattened terminal profile; ribbed treads, comb plates and blank signage remain visible.
The fixed 6m footprint and 3.6m rise require a compact central incline of approximately 43.7 degrees; engineering suitability is not verified.
corrected_geometry_issues: Replaced the uniform 18-step rise with 22 separate rigid steps, deck-flush ends and graduated risers.
Raised and reshaped skirts and glass base channels; deepened the casing after the first candidate exposed lower tread corners.
limitations: Agent visual review only; owner art approval pending.
Full mall assembly, physical devices, safety and transport engineering are not verified.
